extracted.intended_audience: local community members, viewers of Gilbert Digital / community media, and those interested in municipal news and PR awards
extracted.subtask_description: An Internet Archive item page hosting a community-media video (press-release style) showing a Gilbert town manager receiving the PRSA Phoenix Award, including metadata and download options. The page functions as an archived press-release/video post for local government communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRSA Phoenix Award eligibility/selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Each year one CEO, business leader or community leader outside of the public relations & marketing industries is honored for supporting and elevating the best practices of public relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the selection/eligibility standard for the Phoenix Award — the recipient is typically a non-PR/marketing leader recognized for promoting PR best practices; implies nominees should be external to the PR/marketing profession and have demonstrable support for PR standards.
